subject: Project namespace & API key rollout plan for FinX Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Project namespace & API key rollout plan for FinX Health

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. As we move from discovery to the implementation sprint, I want to lock in the plan for:
- project/namespace naming conventions
- API key seeding and rotation schedule
- scoped roles for initial pilot users and service accounts

Attached are three artifacts I used to outline the approach: a proposed role matrix (redwood_role_matrix_v1.xlsx), our API key management recommendations (finx_api_key_guidelines.pdf), and a short mutual action plan doc. Highlights:

1) Projects & namespaces
- We'll create two Redwood projects for FinX: finx-prod (customer-facing inference) and finx-pilot (internal testing).
- Each project will have an org-prefixed namespace to avoid collisions (finx-prod-us, finx-pilot-us).

2) API keys
- We recommend seeding one non‑privileged service key per environment and one admin key held by FinX SRE for emergency use.
- Keys will be short-lived by default (30 days) with rotation automated via the Key Management API.

3) Roles & invites
- Initial invite set: 2 Admins (SRE), 3 Developers (integration), 2 Product testers. See spreadsheet for precise permissions.

Next steps / asks for FinX: please confirm (by EOD Wednesday)
- which email(s) you want as Admin recipients for the admin key
- preferred project namespace prefix if you want to change from ‘finx’
- whether you require HSM-backed keys (we can enable KMS integration)

I'll loop Dev on the explicit API key seeding runbook after we confirm. Laura will own the rollout schedule and invite cadence.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_role_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), finx_api_key_guidelines.pdf (pdf), mutual_action_plan-20280312.docx (docx)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and the artifacts. Quick answers inline:
- Admin recipients: emma.liu@finxhealth.com and rajesh.patel@finxhealth.com

- HSM/KMS: yes, we need HSM-backed keys for prod.

Can you also add a short step in the runbook describing how to revoke a key immediately (audit traces required for our security team)? Rajesh will own coordination on SSO & SCIM later this week.

Emma, Rajesh —

Thanks — quick tech notes and an ask from my side:

1) KMS/HSM integration
- We support customer‑managed KMS keys via our Private deployment integrations; for hosted customers we can integrate with major cloud KMS providers and enable HSM-backed keys for admin secrets. We'll need the KMS key ARN and a service principal for the cross‑account role.

2) Key revocation / audit
- Immediate revoke is supported; I'll add the exact CLI commands to the runbook. Audit logs are captured to the tenant audit stream and can be shipped to FinX's log sink (S3/CloudWatch).

3) API key seeding runbook (proposed minimal sequence)
- Step 0: Confirm admin emails + namespace prefix (Emma)
- Step 1: Create projects: finxhealth-prod-us, finxhealth-pilot-us (Redwood infra team)
- Step 2: Seed non‑privileged service keys in pilot; create admin key (HSM) and deliver to FinX via secure transfer
- Step 3: Invite pilot users and verify permissions
- Step 4: Schedule rotation task (30 days) and emergency revoke drill

Ask: Rajesh or Emma — can you share the preferred secure transfer method for the initial admin key (DocuSign secure envelope, SFTP, or vault exchange)? We avoid plaintext email for admin keys.

I'll draft the CLI snippets and put them in the MAP document on Drive.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
